Data:Slnev.azita.connie.json.startdescription: Azita and Connie are in unexpectedly business-like negotiations for the purchase of talismanic jewels, by the Suppression Bureau, from Azita's contacts… [Lesson: Anbary & Lapidary]

Data:Slnev.azita.coquille.json.startdescription: 'Breath is the temptation of the soul.' Azita and Coquille are discussing the ways in which beauty can be absorbed through the lungs; and Azita is angling for a connection to Coquille's friend Giorgiou, the cigarette smuggler… [Lesson: Applebright Euphonies]

Data:Slnev.azita.corso.json.startdescription: Corso and Azita are both intrigued by recent government interest in the alchemies of the Sunset Road (and in what that might mean for those who could, say, lay their hands on lost Sunset Road works, even works of uncertain provenance.) [Lesson: Purifications & Exaltations]

Data:Slnev.azita.dagmar.json.startdescription: Azita is negotiating the use of Dagmar's estate to store a shipment of 'entertaining automata'; but Dagmar must satisfy herself first that they 'definitely can't kill anyone. Especially' (she adds)  'anyone important.' [Lesson: Lockworks & Clockworks]

Data:Slnev.azita.douglas.json.startdescription: Douglas is investigating attacks by what he suspects might be the Edge-Names known as the Many-Winged; he asks Azita for a run-down on their nature and their likely moves. She complies, although she repeatedly insists that these Many-Winged must be in the service of the Lionsmith, not the Colonel... [Lesson: Auroral Contemplations]

Data:Slnev.azita.ehsan.json.startdescription: Azita, the Colonel-devotee, listens to Ehsan, who once served the Lionsmith, explain his conception of the Corrivality. 'The Histories are I think not braided, but woven. The Corrivality, back and forth between our masters' - he gestures - 'like a shuttle on a loom...' [Lesson: Stitching & Binding]

Data:Slnev.azita.fraser.json.startdescription: Fraser and Azita are agreeing a complex deal involving a sheep farming operation of Azita's in the Middle East. [Lesson: Furs & Feathers]

Data:Slnev.azita.hokobald.json.startdescription: Last time, Azita and Hokobald arm-wrestled, and though he won, Hokobald's wrist was broken. This time, he demands another match. Azita refuses; after some minutes of wheedling she tells him, with a flash of temper, that last time she let him win, and he won't be so lucky another time. Hokobald, enraged, refuses to believe her; they spend the next half hour arguing the merits of the unstoppable force and the immovable object. [Lesson: Disciplines of the Hammer]

Data:Slnev.azita.morgen.json.startdescription: Azita and Morgen compare their hunts of 'upright prey.' Morgen observes disapprovingly that unlike Azita, she never hunts for pleasure. Azita raises her eyebrows and leaves them there until Morgen dissolves into silvery giggles. [Lesson: Horns & Ivories]

Data:Slnev.azita.olympe.json.startdescription: Olympe is writing a novel where one of the characters is a jewel-smuggler, and she's hoping Azita can help with her research. Azita is understandably suspicious, despite Olympe's repeated assurances that none of this is on the record, but she unbends enough to 'talk rubies' once Olympe explains that the protagonist is based on Dagmar. [Lesson: Anbary & Lapidary]

Data:Slnev.azita.serena.json.startdescription: Azita and Serena discuss those who've made unexpected choices about how to grow Long. Azita asks Serena what she would consider, but Serena shakes her head: 'Not now the Obliviates have gone West. And even had they not, I doubt I would have been able to harden my heart quite enough.' [Lesson: Meniscate Reflections]

Data:Slnev.azita.stanislav.json.startdescription: Azita and Stanislav discuss the Names of the Thunderskin - the seven Instruments whose musics support his rhythm. Azita repeats the tradition that a duendrazon which has known seven caesurae becomes eligible to replace an Instrument. Stanislav shakes his head. 'Duendrazones. An odd choice, I've always thought, to become eternally conscious, and then to pursue the caesura so...' [Lesson: Strings & Songs]

Data:Slnev.azita.visiting.denzil.json.startdescription: Azita is trying to begin a conversation about infantry tactics; but Denzil doesn't seem interested. [Lesson: Disciplines of the Scar]

Data:Slnev.azita.visiting.killes.json.startdescription: Azita and Mr Kille discuss the qualities of the timber of the great cedars of Lebanon. Azita offers to provide a quantity of cypress-wood at a very cheap price; Mr Kille, smiling as usual, refuses. Azita offers a free sample, and Mr Kille's smile vanishes. He apologises, he says, but in Brancrug they have been taught not to accept gifts from visitors to Hush House. [Lesson: Leaves & Thorns]

Data:Slnev.azita.visiting.timothy.json.startdescription: Azita and Reverend Timothy are discussing the films of Ilse Bischoff. 'Horrible,' says Reverend Tim emphatically, of The Open Head. 'But I couldn't stop thinking about it. I wrote a piece for the diocese magazine. They didn't like it very much. Asked me to do another one of my Christmas puzzle columns instead.' [Lesson: Disciplines of the Scar]

Data:Slnev.azita.yvette.json.startdescription: Yvette asks Azita about the Edge-dyad Torgue and Dearday, with whom she has been known to go drinking every century or two. Yvette mentions (casually?) that she's always had a bit of a pash on Dearday. Azita's eyes glitter: 'Have you now.' [Lesson: Edicts Martial]

Data:Slnev.azita.zachary.json.startdescription: Azita and Zachary discuss how to maintain a delicate balance, in the occult or the personal; and also how to dispose of corpses. [Lesson: Sickle & Eclipse]

Data:Slnev.chaima.agdistis.json.startdescription: Chaima is describing for Agdistis one of the dances of the Rif Mountains, her home. Her shoulders twitch as if she might wish to show him, but her dignity keeps her in her seat. From his gentle smile, Agdistis has noticed. [Lesson: Drums & Dances]

Data:Slnev.chaima.aladim.json.startdescription: Chaima and al-Adim are comparing navigation techniques. [Lesson: Path & Pilgrim]

Data:Slnev.chaima.arthur.json.startdescription: Chaima and Arthur are discussing the difficulties of desert campaigns, in Algeria and in Persia; the clarity of the stars; the ubiquity of sand; the tales told at the water's edge. [Lesson: Sand Stories]

Data:Slnev.chaima.arun.json.startdescription: Arun is telling stories of the times when he was still numbered among the Great Hooded Princes - stories of the indirect wars they waged against the invaders of their adoptive country - the rivers they roused, the lions they made… [Lesson: Edicts Martial]

Data:Slnev.chaima.azita.json.startdescription: Chaima and Azita are discussing the darts of the Tragulari, the order who once hunted immortals - their forging, their shaping, and the nasty little curses placed upon them to strengthen the poisons they bore. [Lesson: Sharps]

Data:Slnev.chaima.connie.json.startdescription: Chaima and Connie are discussing - with sorrow - the 'khalvites', those labhites who have chosen to drink what Echidna offers… [Lesson: Wolf Stories]

Data:Slnev.chaima.coquille.json.startdescription: Chaima and Coquille are discussing 'the poetry of serpents' - the signs that can be read from their tracks, for hunting and for other purposes. Coquille seems unexpectedly knowledgeable about serpents… [Lesson: Preliminal Meter]

Data:Slnev.chaima.corso.json.startdescription: Corso listens intently as Chaima describes a nasty tangle with the Reckoner Mobs - the loan-sharks of lifetime - back in the 20s… [Lesson: Ragged Crossroads]

Data:Slnev.chaima.dagmar.json.startdescription: Dagmar has returned from the Mazabite Pentapolis ('no sign of my friend, probably been et, but charming place, makes a gel wish she could paint.') She's full of news about the region, and Chaima is keen to hear it. Although Dagmar still seems to think she's called 'Charlie'. [Lesson: Sand Stories]

Data:Slnev.chaima.douglas.json.startdescription: Chaima and Douglas are discussing Ilse Bischoff's experimental film The Open Head. 'I saw it in Alexandria,' Chaima offers. 'I think perhaps she was moved by a dream of the Chandler - that when it emerges, it will emerge from war - and from knowledge unwisely shared.' Douglas sucks on his pipe. 'Mrs M wanted to see it,' he says morosely. 'She likes that Buñuel too.' He sucks on his pipe again. 'I don't like that Buñuel.' [Lesson: Disciplines of the Scar]

Data:Slnev.chaima.ehsan.json.startdescription: Chaima intends to hunt one of the striges, the Many-Winged Ones, who sometimes serve the Colonel and sometimes the Lionsmith. She asks Ehsan what bait she should use, and he replies without hesitation: 'Gossip'. [Lesson: Sky Stories]

Data:Slnev.chaima.fraser.json.startdescription: Fraser is quizzing Chaima about routes across the Algerian desert. [Lesson: Sand Stories]

Data:Slnev.chaima.hokobald.json.startdescription: Chaima speculates about the manner in which she might hunt and defeat Hokobald. Hokobald describes the manner in which he might ensnare and devour her. It is difficult to be sure how much each of them is really enjoying the conversation. [Lesson: Disciplines of the Hammer]

Data:Slnev.chaima.morgen.json.startdescription: Chaima outright asks Morgen whether she - and the other Ligeians - are names of the Twins. Morgen responds with theatrical shock; she makes allusions that suggest it is so; she makes other allusions that imply she's associated with the Grail, the Meniscate, or the Blackbone. [Lesson: Sky Stories]

Data:Slnev.chaima.olympe.json.startdescription: Towards the end of the meal, Chaima speaks, reluctantly, at first, about what she calls 'the wind's footprints'. She demonstrates by scratching the table with her knife: signs in the language called, informally 'Cracktrack'. The signs, Chaima explains, are an account of one of her hunts, although she won't name the quarry in any human language. [Lesson: Cracktrack]

Data:Slnev.chaima.serena.json.startdescription: Chaima describes her defeat in the Bounds at the hands of a 'door-watcher' she names Forculus. Serena, fascinated, tries to draw her out: is Forculus truly a Name of Janus? Is Janus, then, real? Chaima denies interest in either of these questions - and adds quietly that it is unwise of Serena to ask them. [Lesson: Auroral Contemplations]

Data:Slnev.chaima.stanislav.ehsan.json.startdescription: Stanislav, Chaima and Ehsan are discussing the treatment of wounds caused by great beasts: tarrasques and raveleurs; the great serpents called Younger Sisters for their kinship with the Mother of Ants; labhites and skaptodons. When Chaima mentions skaptodons, Stanislav glances sideways at Ehsan. Ehsan waves a dismissive hand, smiling: but afterwards, an old pain creeps over his face. [Lesson: Stitching & Binding]

Data:Slnev.chaima.stanislav.json.startdescription: Stanislav and Chaima are discussing the treatment of wounds caused by great beasts: labhites and skaptodons; tarrasques and raveleurs; and the great serpents called Younger Sisters for their kinship with the Mother of Ants. [Lesson: Stitching & Binding]

Data:Slnev.chaima.visiting.denzil.json.startdescription: Denzil and Chaima are engaged in some sort of contest where each of them hold the palm of a hand over a candle-flame for increasingly long periods of time. Chaima provides occasional philosophical interjections. [Lesson: Sharps]

Data:Slnev.chaima.visiting.killes.json.startdescription: Mrs Kille and Chaima commiserate about the near-impossibility of finding decent coffee in England. [Lesson: Spices & Savours]

Data:Slnev.chaima.visiting.timothy.json.startdescription: Reverend Timothy, having determined to his own satisfaction that Chaima is someone with an interest in aquatic snails, continues to talk to Chaima about aquatic snails. Chaima listens with a huntress' patience. [Lesson: Pearl & Tide]

Data:Slnev.chaima.yvette.json.startdescription: Chaima asks Yvette to interpret a dream - of a white waste west of the world where pale mutes redden the snow with the blood of a bull… [Lesson: Snow Stories]

Data:Slnev.chaima.zachary.json.startdescription: Chaima and Zachary discuss regrets, one hunter to another. [Lesson: Ragged Crossroads]
